### Features

- **common**: refactor the built-in console logger class #6142 #5353, separate out `Logger` wrapper class and `ConsoleLogger` class, add buffering logs feature (buffer init logs and flush them out when a custom logger is assigned), add log level output #6172, support log levels feature nestjs/docs.nestjs.com#1613
- **common**: add `StreamableFile` class for streaming files from controller routes (cross-platform) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/5278
- **common**: add `ParseFloatPipe` and `ParseEnumPipe` classes https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6232
- **core**: add lazy module loader class https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6386
- **core**: add `RouterModule` for defining per-module controller prefixes 
- **core**: add the ability to exclude certain routes from the global prefix https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/5291
- **core**: API versioning feature https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6278
- **microservices**: support multiple event subscribers (`@EventPattern()` can be applied to multiple methods) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6334
- **microservices**: support passing a property key to the `@Payload()` decorator https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/5975
- **websockets**: support passing a property key to the `@MessageBody()` decorator
- **websockets**: (`WsAdapter`) support registering gateways on different paths and let them share the same HTTP server https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6321

### Improvements

- **core**: sort modules topologically when invoking lifecycle hooks https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6236
- **core**: use class references as providers/controllers/injectables keys instead of their names 
- https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6141 fixes https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/5591 and https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/789
- **core**: `BaseExceptionFilter` supports `http-errors` (and any other error objects that have the `statusCode` property specified) out of the box now https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6349/commits/cdd51b002888e2d4f249c271a958f8e7e1381997
- **core**: set `Error.name` property to the name of the class (all exceptions that inherit from the built-in `HttpException`) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/5859

### Bug fixes

- **common**: add a missing type argument to `mixin()` function https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6216
- **core**: use `router.all()` method for routes annotated with the `@All()` decorator (instead of `router.use()`) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6237
- **core**: reject on server bind failures (`listen()`) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/3360
- **websockets**: specify `@nestjs/platform-socket.io` as an optional peer dependency to support PnP mode https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6217

### Dependencies

- **microservices**: update to use `@grpc/grpc-js` package (instead of `grpc`) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/4806
- **microservices**: upgrade NATS to v2 🙌 
- **platform-socket.io**: upgrade Socket.io to v4 🙌 

### Deprecations

- **common**: deprecate `HttpModule` to remove hard dependency on the `axios` library. `HttpModule` is published as a new `@nestjs/axios` package now
- **core**: deprecate the `listenAsync()` (use `listen()`) and `startAllMicroservicesAsync()` (use `startAllMicroservices()`) methods
- **microservices**: deprecate the `listenAsync()` method (use `listen()` instead)

- **core**: support async lifecycle hooks (`OnModuleInit` and `OnModuleDestroy`) [#569](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/569)
- **core**: HTTP server independence, [fastify](https://github.com/fastify/fastify) integration (`FastifyAdapter`)
- **core**: allow binding global interceptors, filters, pipes, and guards from any module. Example:
```typescript
{
  provide: APP_INTERCEPTOR,
  useClass: LoggerInterceptor,
}
```
- **core**: `@UseGuards()`, `@UsePipes()`, `@UseFilters()`, and `@UseInterceptors()` extend metadata, instead of overriding existing one
- **core**: dependency injection everywhere (pipes, filters, interceptors, and guards)
- **core**: pass `ArgumentsHost` to exception filters (ability to access each argument)
- **core**: pass enhanced `ExecutionContext` to both interceptors and guards (ability to access each argument and execution context)
- **microservices**: rewrite existing transporters (TCP, Redis), provide new strategies: Nats, MQTT, gRPC
- **all**: improve execution context performance (http, ws, microservices)

### Bug Fixes
- **common**: incorrent `multer` dependency [#532](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/532)
- **core**: hanging `NestApplicationContext` process [#503](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/503)
- **microservices**: concurrency issues (both TCP and Redis transporters) [#505](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/505)

### Improvements
- **all**: remove `reflect-metadata` peer dependency [#563](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/563)
- **all**: upgrade RxJS to 6.0.0
- **all**: move to Node.js >= 8.9.0 (TypeScript target `es2017`)
- **core**: more descriptive exceptions (circular dependency) [#493](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/493)
- **core**: Nest container compatible with `useContainer()` (`class-validator` and `typeorm` packages) [#528](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/528)
- **core**: remove static dependencies (webpack compatibility)
- **websockets**: `@WebSocketGateway()` takes options argument that is passed to socket.io instance [#508](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/508)

### Deprecations
- **common**: deprecate `@Component()`, `@Middleware()`, `@Interceptor()`, `@Pipe()`, and `@Guard()` decorators (use `@Injectable()` instead)
- **common**: removed `ExpressMiddleware` (use `MiddlewareFunction`)
- **core**: deprecate `modules: []` property (use `imports: []` instead)
- **core**: deprecate `components: []` property (use `providers: []` instead)
- **core**: removed `MiddlewaresConsumer` (use `MiddlewareConsumer`)

### Notes
- move from traditional express middleware model: each middleware is solely bounded to a particular path, regardless of the request method

### Features
- **core**: support async lifecycle hooks (`OnModuleInit` and `OnModuleDestroy`) [#569](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/569)
- **core**: HTTP server independence, [fastify](https://github.com/fastify/fastify) integration (`FastifyAdapter`)
- **core**: allow binding global interceptors, filters, pipes, and guards from any module. Example:
```typescript
{
  provide: APP_INTERCEPTOR,
  useClass: LoggerInterceptor,
}
```
- **core**: `@UseGuards()`, `@UsePipes()`, `@UseFilters()`, and `@UseInterceptors()` extend metadata, instead of overriding existing one
- **core**: dependency injection everywhere (pipes, filters, interceptors, and guards)
- **core**: pass `ArgumentsHost` to exception filters (ability to access each argument)
- **core**: pass enhanced `ExecutionContext` to both interceptors and guards (ability to access each argument and execution context)
- **microservices**: improve existing transporters (TCP, Redis), provide new strategies: Nats, MQTT, gRPC

### Bug Fixes
- **common**: incorrent `multer` dependency [#532](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/532)
- **core**: hanging `NestApplicationContext` process [#503](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/503)
- **microservices**: concurrency issues (both TCP and Redis transporters) [#505](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/505)

### Improvements
- **all**: remove `reflect-metadata` peer dependency [#563](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/563)
- **all**: upgrade RxJS (make use of pipeable operators)
- **core**: more descriptive exceptions (circular dependency) [#493](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/493)
- **core**: Nest container compatible with `useContainer()` (`class-validator` and `typeorm` packages) [#528](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/528)
- **core**: remove static dependencies (webpack compatibility)
- **websockets**: `@WebSocketGateway()` takes options argument that is passed to socket.io instance [#508](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/508)

### Deprecations
- **common**: deprecate `@Component()`, `@Middleware()`, `@Interceptor()`, `@Pipe()`, and `@Guard()` decorators (use `@Injectable()` instead)
- **core**: deprecate `modules: []` property (use `imports: []` instead)
- **core**: deprecate `components: []` property (use `providers: []` instead)

### Notes
- move from traditional express middleware model: each middleware is solely bounded to a particular path, regardless of the request method"},{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/nestjs/nest/releases/10033375","assets_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/nestjs/nest/releases/10033375/assets","upload_url":"https://uploads.github.com/repos/nestjs/nest/releases/10033375/assets{?name,label}","html_url":"https://github.com/nestjs/nest/releases/tag/v4.6.6","id":10033375,"author":{"login":"kamilmysliwiec","id":23244943,"node_id":"MDQ6VXNlcjIzMjQ0OTQz","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/23244943?v=4","gravatar_id":"","url":"https://api.github.com/users/kamilmysliwiec","html_url":"https://github.com/kamilmysliwiec","followers_url":"https://api.github.com/users/kamilmysliwiec/followers","following_url":"https://api.github.com/users/kamilmysliwiec/following{/other_user}","gists_url":"https://api.github.com/users/kamilmysliwiec/gists{/gist_id}","starred_url":"https://api.github.com/users/kamilmysliwiec/starred{/owner}{/repo}","subscriptions_url":"https://api.github.com/users/kamilmysliwiec/subscriptions","organizations_url":"https://api.github.com/users/kamilmysliwiec/orgs","repos_url":"https://api.github.com/users/kamilmysliwiec/repos","events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/kamilmysliwiec/events{/privacy}","received_events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/kamilmysliwiec/received_events","type":"User","user_view_type":"public","site_admin":false},"node_id":"MDc6UmVsZWFzZTEwMDMzMzc1","tag_name":"v4.6.6","target_commitish":"master","name":"v4.6.6","draft":false,"immutable":false,"prerelease":false,"created_at":"2018-03-11T12:47:31Z","updated_at":"2018-03-11T12:52:34Z","published_at":"2018-03-11T12:52:34Z","assets":[],"tarball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/nestjs/nest/tarball/v4.6.6","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/nestjs/nest/zipball/v4.6.6","body":"### Bug Fixes:

- **core**: remove static dependencies & relationships inside `NestFactory`

### Features

- **common**: refactor the built-in console logger class #6142 #5353, separate out `Logger` wrapper class and `ConsoleLogger` class, add buffering logs feature (buffer init logs and flush them out when a custom logger is assigned), add log level output #6172, support log levels feature nestjs/docs.nestjs.com#1613
- **common**: add `StreamableFile` class for streaming files from controller routes (cross-platform) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/5278
- **common**: add `ParseFloatPipe` and `ParseEnumPipe` classes https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6232
- **core**: add lazy module loader class https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6386
- **core**: add `RouterModule` for defining per-module controller prefixes 
- **core**: add the ability to exclude certain routes from the global prefix https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/5291
- **core**: API versioning feature https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6278
- **microservices**: support multiple event subscribers (`@EventPattern()` can be applied to multiple methods) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6334
- **microservices**: support passing a property key to the `@Payload()` decorator https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/5975
- **websockets**: support passing a property key to the `@MessageBody()` decorator
- **websockets**: (`WsAdapter`) support registering gateways on different paths and let them share the same HTTP server https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6321

### Improvements

- **core**: sort modules topologically when invoking lifecycle hooks https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6236
- **core**: use class references as providers/controllers/injectables keys instead of their names 
- https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6141 fixes https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/5591 and https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/789
- **core**: `BaseExceptionFilter` supports `http-errors` (and any other error objects that have the `statusCode` property specified) out of the box now https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6349/commits/cdd51b002888e2d4f249c271a958f8e7e1381997
- **core**: set `Error.name` property to the name of the class (all exceptions that inherit from the built-in `HttpException`) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/5859

### Bug fixes

- **common**: add a missing type argument to `mixin()` function https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6216
- **core**: use `router.all()` method for routes annotated with the `@All()` decorator (instead of `router.use()`) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6237
- **core**: reject on server bind failures (`listen()`) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/3360
- **websockets**: specify `@nestjs/platform-socket.io` as an optional peer dependency to support PnP mode https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/6217

### Dependencies

- **microservices**: update to use `@grpc/grpc-js` package (instead of `grpc`) https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/4806
- **microservices**: upgrade NATS to v2 🙌 
- **platform-socket.io**: upgrade Socket.io to v4 🙌 

### Deprecations

- **common**: deprecate `HttpModule` to remove hard dependency on the `axios` library. `HttpModule` is published as a new `@nestjs/axios` package now
- **core**: deprecate the `listenAsync()` (use `listen()`) and `startAllMicroservicesAsync()` (use `startAllMicroservices()`) methods
- **microservices**: deprecate the `listenAsync()` method (use `listen()` instead)

{
  provide: APP_INTERCEPTOR,
  useClass: LoggerInterceptor,
}

- **core**: pass `ArgumentsHost` to exception filters (ability to access each argument)
- **core**: pass enhanced `ExecutionContext` to both interceptors and guards (ability to access each argument and execution context)
- **microservices**: rewrite existing transporters (TCP, Redis), provide new strategies: Nats, MQTT, gRPC

- **core**: hanging `NestApplicationContext` process [#503](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/503)
- **microservices**: concurrency issues (both TCP and Redis transporters) [#505](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/505)

### Improvements
- **all**: remove `reflect-metadata` peer dependency [#563](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/563)
- **all**: upgrade RxJS to 6.0.0

- **core**: more descriptive exceptions (circular dependency) [#493](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/493)
- **core**: Nest container compatible with `useContainer()` (`class-validator` and `typeorm` packages) [#528](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/528)
- **core**: remove static dependencies (webpack compatibility)
- **websockets**: `@WebSocketGateway()` takes options argument that is passed to socket.io instance [#508](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/508)

### Deprecations
- **common**: deprecate `@Component()`, `@Middleware()`, `@Interceptor()`, `@Pipe()`, and `@Guard()` decorators (use `@Injectable()` instead)
- **common**: removed `ExpressMiddleware` (use `MiddlewareFunction`)
- **core**: deprecate `modules: []` property (use `imports: []` instead)
- **core**: deprecate `components: []` property (use `providers: []` instead)
- **core**: removed `MiddlewaresConsumer` (use `MiddlewareConsumer`)

### Notes
- move from traditional express middleware model: each middleware is solely bounded to a particular path, regardless of the request method
